traps.description: A pit trap with sharp spikes awaits your misstep.
Darts shoot from the walls, laced with poison!

puzzles.question: What has keys but can't open locks?
puzzles.description: A stone door with mysterious runes... solve the riddle to proceed.
An ancient lock with symbols that must be aligned.

rooms.description: The air smells foul, and the flicker of torches reveals claw marks on the walls. Suddenly, goblins leap from the shadows, brandishing crude weapons!
Golden light dances across the stone walls, reflecting off a chest surrounded by old bones. The air is stale, yet the glint of treasure beckons.
Rusty armor lines the walls, but one polished shield gleams with a faint magical aura. Dust swirls beneath your boots as you approach.
The shattered remains of an altar sit at the far end of the room. Flickering candles reveal a shadowy figure in tattered robes muttering dark incantations.
The walls are adorned with eerie portraits. As you pass, the eyes seem to follow you... then, one of the faces sneers and a dart shoots from the wall!
Rubble partially blocks the path. You may need to clear some stones to continue, but the shifting pile looks unstable.
Ancient books line the shelves, but one seems to glow faintly. A cryptic note warns: 'Knowledge is power, but choose wisely...'

corridors.description: A long, narrow corridor with eerie whispers echoing through it.
A foggy corridor where visibility is almost zero.

boss_fights.description: A powerful demon blocks your path!
An orc chieftain guards the dungeon's treasure hoard!
